title: Confirm local workset inputs and output contract
objective: Confirm source files, workset folder, release workbook name, QA artifact names, and read-only source policy.

title: Inventory workbook sheets and source shape
objective: Profile sheet names, dimensions, header rows, data rows, mapped cells, and source hash.

title: Normalize canonical QSEN rows and AACN mapping cells
objective: Forward-fill merged QSEN fields, split comma-separated subcompetency codes, preserve raw cells, and flag review conditions.

title: Build dimensions and fact table
objective: Build QSEN domain, KSA, AACN domain, AACN competency, and QSEN statement tables.

title: Build QSEN to AACN bridge table
objective: Create one bridge row per QSEN statement to AACN subcompetency code while preserving source row and cell provenance.

title: Build flattened canonical master
objective: Join normalized QSEN rows, AACN competency metadata, subcompetency mappings, provenance, and review status into a release table.

title: Build coverage and review outputs
objective: Summarize mapping coverage by QSEN domain, KSA, AACN domain, and review reason.

title: Assemble Excel release workbook
objective: Create the final local workbook with README, Summary, Provenance, Data Dictionary, dimensions, fact, bridge, master, coverage, and review queue sheets.

title: Validate release and write QA manifest
objective: Write QA JSON with source hash, source counts, bridge counts, review queue count, and reconciliation status.
